grace: She skates on the ice with grace.
她在冰上滑得优雅极了。
What grace the jumping cat has!
这只跳跃的猫咪姿态多优雅呀！
graduation: Graduation is a big day for my sister.
毕业典礼对姐姐来说是个大日子。
She gets a gift at her graduation.
她在毕业典礼上收到了礼物。
你的毕业典礼是什么时候呀？
grasp: The baby grasps her blanket at night.
小宝宝晚上紧紧抓着她的小毯子。
Monkeys grasp the tree with their feet.
猴子用脚紧紧抓住树干。
grassland: Many zebras run on the big grassland.
许多斑马在大草原上奔跑。
The grassland is green in summer.
What animals live on the grassland?
草原上都住着哪些动物呀？
greased: Mother greased the pan for the corn bread.
妈妈给平底锅抹上油，好做玉米面包。
He greased the old wagon wheels.
他给旧马车的车轮上了润滑油。
greed: Greed is wanting more and more.
贪心就是想要越来越多。
Greed made him take all the cookies.
贪心让他把饼干全拿走了。
Why is greed a bad thing?
greenhouse: The greenhouse is warm and wet inside.
温室里面又暖和又湿润。
Grandfather keeps his plants in the greenhouse.
爷爷把他的植物养在温室里。
Why is the greenhouse warm in winter?
冬天温室里为什么暖和呀？
greenhouse effect: The greenhouse effect warms the air.
温室效应会让空气变暖。
Too much greenhouse effect is bad.
greenhouse gas: Greenhouse gas makes the air warmer.
温室气体让空气变得更暖。
Cars and fires make greenhouse gas.
汽车和火都会产生温室气体。
What greenhouse gas comes from cars?
汽车排放的温室气体是什么呀？
griddle: The griddle is a big flat pan.
煎锅是一口又大又平的锅。
Mother makes eggs on the hot griddle.
妈妈在热煎锅上煎鸡蛋。
Look at the bread on the griddle!
grievance: The team has one grievance about the game.
关于这场比赛，队伍里有一个不满。
Tell me your grievance, little one.
小家伙，把你的委屈说出来吧。
grieve: The family grieves for their old dog.
一家人为他们的老狗伤心难过。
Friends help you when you grieve.
你伤心的时候，朋友们会帮你。
人为什么会伤心难过呢？
grit: There was grit in my shoe.
Wash the grit off your bike.
把你自行车上的沙粒洗掉吧。
Do you feel the grit under your feet?
你感觉到脚下的沙粒了吗？
grope: At night I grope for the light.
晚上我会摸黑去找灯的开关。
He groped for his other sock under the bed.
他在床底下摸索着找另一只袜子。
Did you grope for the ticket in your bag?
你在包里摸找车票了吗？
grounds: The school grounds are big and green.
The park grounds have many tall trees.
公园的场地上有很多高高的树。
groundwater: We drink clean groundwater from the well.
我们喝井里打上来的干净地下水。
Groundwater is under the dirt and rocks.
地下水藏在泥土和岩石下面。
Do not put bad things into the groundwater.
不要把脏东西弄进地下水里。
grout: Father put new white grout on the wall.
爸爸在墙上填了新的白色填缝剂。
The old grout near the bathtub is black.
浴缸旁边的旧填缝剂黑黑的。
grudge: He keeps a grudge about the game.
他还在为那场比赛耿耿于怀。
A grudge is a bad feeling.
怨恨是一种不好的情绪。
Do not keep a grudge about small things.
别为一点儿小事就记仇哦。
grueling: The grueling soccer game made us hot.
这场累人的足球赛把我们热坏了。
The long walk home was grueling.
走那么长的路回家真累人。
gryphon: The gryphon has wings and an eagle's head.
狮鹫长着翅膀，还有老鹰的头。
The fairy and the gryphon are friends.
